meaning: The wallet that opened and funded the session. Recorded as `call.caller` on every delegated call and receives remaining budget on close.
The ephemeral keypair authorized to sign `open_session_call` and `open_session_metered_call` without further caller signatures.
Caller-chosen u64 nonce deriving the Session PDA `["session", caller, delegate, nonce_le]`.
The mint of the session budget. The default (all-zero) address means native SOL.
Optional model restriction. The default (all-zero) address allows any live model priced in `mint`.
Total escrow deposited into the session in base units of `mint`.
Cumulative escrow debited from the session across opened calls.
Number of calls opened under this session.
The slot the session was opened in.
The last slot the delegate may open new calls. After it, anyone may call `close_session` to return unspent budget to `caller`.
